description: This pavement image collection spans two public Zenodo deposits, Part 1 and Part 2, for selected National Highway N6 segments in Pabna District, Bangladesh. The article reports 12,000 raw smartphone images, 4,000 each for alligator cracking, edge breaks and intact pavement. The repositories describe a further 12,000 augmented files and organized training, validation and testing subsets. Each part has its own DOI and ZIP archive; both pages state CC BY 4.0. The two parts are treated as one logical dataset and both addresses are retained. Coverage is close-range imagery from one road corridor under daylight, not measured pavement structural capacity or a time series of deterioration. Camera position, manual labelling and possible scene overlap limit transfer to other networks; split contents were not checked. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is testing visual condition-classification inputs before scheduling road inspections. data-lira-cd-road-condition-copenhagen is a related road-condition source. The other Bangladesh BD-PaveSurface release has different stated classes and counts; image-level overlap between the collections remains unknown. Neither ZIP was downloaded.
